sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-abliterated-GGUF is a GGUF-quantized version of the Qwen2.5 Vision Language model optimized for local CPU and GPU inference. Built and maintained by mradermacher, this model processes both images and text through a multimodal architecture, enabling vision-language understanding tasks on consumer hardware.
